chemistry-killer-12.topic: Xawaaraha falgalka, mabda'a Le Chatelier iyo unugga kimikada
chemistry-killer-12.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-12.material: Heerkul 25 °C, acetic acid ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) waxay leedahay $\mathrm{p}K_a = 4.7$. Isku-dar 0.20 M $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ 100 mL iyo 0.10 M $\mathrm{CH_3COONa}$ 100 mL si aad u sameyso buffer solution. Marka lagu daro 1.0 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 10 mL, waa maxay pH-ka xalka? (Isbeddelka xoogga ee ka dhasha isbeddelka mugga saamayn kuma yeesho xisaabinta saamiga, isticmaal $\log 2 = 0.30$. Marka la qasayo NaOH wuxuu si buuxda ula falgalaa acetic acid.)
chemistry-killer-12.thinking.0: Xawaaraha falgalka, mabda'a Le Chatelier iyo unugga kimikada
chemistry-killer-12.s.s1.prompt: Heerkul 25 °C, acetic acid ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) waxay leedahay $\mathrm{p}K_a = 4.7$. Isku-dar 0.20 M $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ 100 mL iyo 0.10 M $\mathrm{CH_3COONa}$ 100 mL si aad u sameyso buffer solution. Marka lagu daro 1.0 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 10 mL, waa maxay pH-ka xalka? (Isbeddelka xoogga ee ka dhasha isbeddelka mugga saamayn kuma yeesho xisaabinta saamiga, isticmaal $\log 2 = 0.30$. Marka la qasayo NaOH wuxuu si buuxda ula falgalaa acetic acid.)
chemistry-killer-12.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabo 1: Mole-ka bilowga. HA = 20 mmol, A⁻ = 10 mmol (pH-ka bilowga = 4.7 + log 0.5 = 4.7 − 0.30 = 4.4).
